name: Adopted
title: Adopted
description: Which way a person was adopted, on their Patient in a GA4GH pedigree: `in` (adopted into this family) or `out` (adopted away from it). open-pedigree writes `in` for an adopted person with no parents in the pedigree; an adopted child whose adoptive parents are in the pedigree is described by those KIN:022 (isAdoptiveParent) relationships instead. `out` is defined for a later version and not yet written or read.
